sets.title: Five unrelated single-responsibility services
sets.description: Payroll calendar, DNS record parser, image thumbnailer, rate limiter, and sitemap builder — five utterly unrelated files with no duplicated region. A perfect detector reports zero clusters; this measures the false-positive floor.

traps.reason: deliberate false-positive bait: the declare(strict_types=1) + namespace + final-class declaration scaffold is byte-identical across all five files. It is the only shape shared between any two files here and a low-threshold token/line detector may be tempted to pair it, but it is ubiquitous PHP boilerplate, not a duplicated implementation.
deliberate false-positive bait: same class-declaration scaffold shared verbatim with every other file. A detector pairing this header would be reporting shared boilerplate, not a real clone.
